function.name: get_current_time
function.description: Get the current date and time on the server, optionally in a specific IANA timezone (e.g. Europe/Berlin). Use whenever freshness, "today", or a timezone matters.

function.name: read_project_file
function.description: Read an attached source or enabled instruction skill by its name as listed. Skills support offset pagination. For PDFs use startPage/endPage (up to 5 pages) and offset to read beyond summaries; results include page and version references.

name.description: File name as listed (e.g. Folder/Text/notes.md), or just notes.md if unique

function.name: drive_search_files
function.description: Search the user's Google Drive (files noevia created or was given) by name or text.

function.name: drive_read_file
function.description: Read a text file, Google Doc, Sheet (as CSV) or Slides deck from Google Drive, by Drive file id. Not for files uploaded to this project; use the project file tools for those.

fileId.description: Drive file id from a search or list result

function.name: drive_get_metadata
function.description: Get a Google Drive file's name, type, size, dates and link.

fileId.description: Drive file id from a search or list result

function.name: drive_list_recent
function.description: List the most recently changed files in Google Drive.

function.name: drive_create_file
function.description: Create a new text file in the user's Google Drive. Not for files uploaded to this project; use the project file tools for those.

function.name: drive_update_file
function.description: Replace the whole content of a text file in Google Drive, by Drive file id. Read it with drive_read_file first, in the same reply. Not for files uploaded to this project; use the project file tools for those.

fileId.description: Drive file id from a search or list result

function.name: drive_trash_file
function.description: Move a Google Drive file to the trash (recoverable for 30 days).

fileId.description: Drive file id from a search or list result

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web (QA).

function.name: web_news
function.description: Recent news (QA).

function.name: nc_notes_search_notes
function.description: Search QA notes.

function.name: nc_notes_create_note
function.description: Create a QA note.
